topicName: Explain the difference between 'public', 'private', and 'protected' access modifiers.
content: [{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Explain the difference between 'public', 'private', and 'protected' access modifiers."},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"Access modifiers control the visibility and accessibility of class members (variables, methods) from different parts of the program. They are fundamental to encapsulation in object-oriented programming."}]
